result.summary: Found 2 issues: critical low contrast making the promo banner text nearly invisible, and a minor inconsistency in delivery time badge formatting.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a very light mint background and is nearly unreadable due to extremely low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color with sufficient contrast against the light background or darken the banner background if white text must be kept

issues.description: Delivery time badges in 'Fastest near you' use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' with no spaces versus '20-30 min' with spaces around the dash on the third card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize time-range format across all badges, e.g., consistently use '20–30 min' with en-dash and spacing
